title: Harden pi-goal lifecycle and activity ownership
description: Fix remaining pi-goal design defects: settle runtime at agent_settled rather than agent_end, preserve lifecycle continuity after startup, invalidate evaluations after failed non-read-only tools, and harden active-tool synchronization. Add regression coverage and update context.

logs.msg: Reproduced lifecycle defects from Pi agent-session ordering. Moved runtime finalization and continuation dispatch to agent_settled, retained stop reason across retries, preserved automatic-compaction leases, and restored fenced manual-compaction recovery after the abort-before-hook boundary. Cleared startup gating on admitted input and explicit /goal actions. Failed non-control tools now invalidate pending evaluations; retry turn accounting uses per-message markers plus a monotonic run sequence.
Verification complete: bun test passed 38 tests and 86 expectations; bunx tsc --noEmit passed; git diff --check passed. Live Pi/provider smoke testing remains unavailable.
